author: Luna agent
label: Development set; not a final benchmark

cases.question: At Bank, I want to switch between the Waterloo & City and DLR lines. Is that an all-inside interchange, and can you show the interchange location?
required_points: Identify Bank as the station being mapped; Waterloo & City is a line name here, not a separate destination pin.
The step-free Waterloo & City interchange with Northern/DLR uses about 290 metres via street and lifts, so it is not entirely inside the station.
The Waterloo & City lifts at Bank use Walbrook on weekdays; do not imply current lift status or a guaranteed gap-free journey.
forbidden_claims: Do not pin Waterloo station merely because Waterloo & City is named.
Do not describe the interchange as entirely within the station or promise present lift availability.

cases.question: Our day starts at the Natural History Museum and ends by the National Gallery. Can you show both endpoints on a map?
required_points: Include the Natural History Museum as the stated start and the National Gallery anchor as the stated end.
Use origin and destination roles that follow the user's explicit wording.
Do not invent a route line or claim a verified journey.
forbidden_claims: Do not reverse the stated endpoints or add unrelated museums as stops.
Do not imply that the map pins show exact entrances.

cases.question: I’m deciding between Greenwich Park and Hyde Park for a future visit. Could you place both on one map so I can compare their locations?
required_points: Show both named parks together as contextual locations; neither is an origin or a chosen destination yet.
Keep the answer brief and do not invent distances or travel times.
forbidden_claims: Do not assign an origin or destination role to either park.
Do not add unrelated Greenwich venues or other parks as if the user requested them.

cases.question: I’m setting aside a couple of hours for the National Theatre, OXO Tower Wharf, and Tate Modern. What does the published walking-time estimate for a riverside stroll tell me?
required_points: The published estimate is about 30 minutes from Lambeth Bridge to Blackfriars Bridge without extended stops; individual pace varies.
Do not transfer that estimate to the National Theatre–Tate Modern leg or claim it covers visits and stops.
Describe the itinerary as a suggestion, not verified turn-by-turn directions or an audited accessible route.
forbidden_claims: Do not call the entire requested venue sequence a 30-minute walk.
Do not certify an accessible route, entrance, ramp, or journey from the map anchors.

cases.question: I tapped into the Tube with a physical contactless card but touched out with its linked phone, then used the phone on a bus. Did I use the right touches, and could the rail fare be affected?
required_points: A phone and its linked physical card are separate payment identities; rail entry and exit need the same card or device.
A missing or mismatched rail touch can lead to a maximum fare; do not claim the exact fare charged.
On a bus, touch in only. This general payment question needs no map pin.
forbidden_claims: Do not treat the physical card and phone as interchangeable because they share a bank account.
Do not promise that a particular charge was or will be applied.

cases.question: For an indoor afternoon, can you compare the V&A and the Science Museum on free general admission and whether I should book?
required_points: Both museums offer free general admission, with separate charges possible for some exhibitions, events, or experiences.
V&A South Kensington general admission does not need booking; Science Museum asks visitors to pre-book a free ticket.
Show both as contextual options because the user is comparing them and has not selected one.
forbidden_claims: Do not say that both general admissions require booking or that either is guaranteed open now.
Do not imply all exhibitions or experiences are free.
